name: webpack
description: Packs ECMAScript/CommonJs/AMD modules for the browser. Allows you to split your codebase into multiple bundles, which can be loaded on demand. Supports loaders to preprocess files, i.e. json, jsx, es7, css, less, ... and your custom stuff.

repo.name: webpack
repo.description: A bundler for javascript and friends. Packs many modules into a few bundled assets. Code Splitting allows for loading parts of the application on demand. Through "loaders", modules can be CommonJs, AMD, ES6 modules, CSS, Images, JSON, Coffeescript, LESS, ... and your custom stuff.

cves.summary: webpack buildHttp: allowedUris allow-list bypass via URL userinfo (@) leading to build-time SSRF behavior
webpack buildHttp HttpUriPlugin allowedUris bypass via HTTP redirects → SSRF + cache persistence
Webpack's AutoPublicPathRuntimeModule has a DOM Clobbering Gadget that leads to XSS

readme.summary: The README provides a clear high-level description and basic install instructions but defers almost all practical guidance to external docs, leaving users with no working examples or configuration reference in the README itself.
readme.top_issue: No inline quick-start example or configuration snippet — users are immediately redirected to the external website for anything beyond installation.

common_complaints: Asset path placeholders broken with virtual modules
Tree-shaking fails to remove unused default exports
Externals handling inconsistent with ESM and AMD library targets
praise_themes: Active issue engagement with detailed discussions
sentiment.summary: Webpack maintains moderate community health with active issue engagement, though some substantive bugs (tree-shaking, build configuration) remain unresolved for weeks.

red_flags: Ignoring or dismissing low-quality contributions without constructive feedback
Lack of detailed explanations for some decisions
communication.summary: The maintainer responses provide technical insights and address specific issues, but they often lack patience with repeated questions and can be unwelcoming to new contributors, especially those using AI tools.

concerns: 205 open issues with zero closures in past 6 months
Zero pull requests (open or merged) despite high issue count
Zero active contributors in past 6 months
No issue triage or PR activity despite active issue backlog
maintenance.summary: Maintenance appears stale with a large unresolved issue backlog (205 open), no PR activity, and no active contributors despite a recent commit timestamp.

governance.summary: The webpack project has a well-documented decision-making process and multiple maintainers, but lacks an explicit succession plan. There is a clear path for contributors to become maintainers.

risk_factors: Publisher 'GitHub Actions' not in maintainers list
